name: Evidence freshness
questionAnswered: What fraction of eligible observations in the named projection is no older than the declared freshness threshold?

calculation.formula: eligible observations at or within the age threshold divided by all eligible observations
calculation.numeratorDefinition: Eligible admitted observations whose observed time is not later than the as-of time and whose age is within the declared threshold.
calculation.denominatorDefinition: All admitted observations eligible for the named projection, including stale observations but excluding quarantined or future-dated records.
calculation.rounding: Retain six decimal places in machine output; display percentages may round to one decimal place.

scopeSemantics.qualification: The threshold, eligibility rule, oldest included observation, and projection as-of time must be shown together.

interpretation.doesMean: The stated fraction of eligible evidence was observed within the declared age threshold.
doesNotMean: Fresh evidence is accurate or complete.
The underlying asset remains unchanged after observation.
Quarantined or unavailable sources are fresh.
A migration outcome has been verified.
interpretation.whenUnavailable: Show unavailable and identify why no eligible observations or no valid threshold exists.
